description: [PAID $0.5 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Vendor due diligence in one call: seller domain reputation, legal-name sanctions screening (OFAC/UN/EU/UK), product recalls (barcode or keywords) and EU-Ready (Safety Gate, GPSR, ECB price). Returns proceed/review/block with reasons.

domain.description: Seller website domain or URL, e.g. allbirds.com

gtin.description: EAN/UPC barcode for exact recall and Safety Gate matches

product_url.description: Product page URL for the EU-Ready check

query.description: Product words for keyword recall search when there is no barcode

seller.description: Seller legal name to screen (default: derived from the domain)

name: vendor_due_diligence
